method.client: requests plus one successful isolated browser observation
method.requests_timeout_note: Connect/read socket timeouts, not a guaranteed combined wall-clock deadline across redirects.
method.direct_fallback: Only a transport failure of the official ACL DOI route triggered one TLS-verified direct attempt; no challenge bypass or CAPTCHA solving.
method.identity_policy: Actual title+authors+identifier/publisher resource metadata or browser-rendered official article; 200 and DOI redirect alone do not establish identity.
method.citation_count_policy: No counts refreshed; null remains unknown, never zero.

limitations: All 22 original Scholar URLs executed, but their query/cluster/cites target identity is still blocked; independent official identity confirmation is not a successful Scholar-content audit.

Five AAAI papers have exact Crossref title/DOI/authors/resource matches, but their requests page bodies were Anubis challenges. INFORMEDQX was read in browser; the browser did not expose an HTTP status.
The six-page browser follow-up timed out with no returned observations; do not infer any per-URL outcome from it.
Previously recorded 46 request_unresolved URLs were outside this batch and were not retried; TLS/access failures are not dead-link findings.
No confirmed wrong/dead link in these 22; no mandatory URL replacement. Optional official identity links must not replace historical cited-by/all-versions evidence.
append_summary_template.write_scope: Append-only existing audit ledger plus one small supporting evidence JSON under 原始证据/audit. No edits to main MDs, bibliography, index, .gitignore, tools or commits; no repeat RobustRAG audit.
